scripts-descriptions.pot: Regenerate languages/godam.pot. Run 'npm run build:prod' first. Two passes: the first scans assets/build only, because '*.min.js' is in make-pot's built-in exclude list and needs an explicit --include to outrank it; the second scans everything else and merges, so each entry carries both a built reference (which is what WordPress hashes to find JS translations at runtime) and a source reference (which is what translators read).
